stories.title: Two More Dresser Recalls This Week — Gizoon and Alanca Added to CPSC Tip-Over List (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Two more dresser recalls this week: Gizoon (~4,396 units, recalled Sept 3) and Alanca 6-drawer wood dressers (~261 units from Wayfair).

Both can tip over and trap children if not wall-anchored. Stop using if unsecured.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
That's 3 dresser tip-over recalls in one week: Walmart Mainstays (Sept 5), Gizoon (Sept 3), and Alanca (Wayfair, ~261 units).

If your dresser isn't bolted to the wall, anchor it today.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: Two More Dressers Recalled for Tip-Over Hazard — Gizoon and Alanca Added to CPSC List

stories.title: Labor Day Lift Off Day 2 — Sunday Morning Launches at 7 AM, Final Balloon Glow Tonight (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Labor Day Lift Off Day 2 at Memorial Park. Morning balloon launches at 7 AM — arrive by 6:30 AM to get close.

Tonight: the final Balloon Glow of the weekend. All 65 balloons light up at dusk. Free admission.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Last Balloon Glow of the 50th Labor Day Lift Off is tonight at Memorial Park.

Free to watch. Tethered rides for ages 5+. Wings of Blue skydiving. Grizzly drone show.

Don't sleep on Sunday — it's the best day.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: AAP Issues 2026–2027 COVID-19 Vaccine Guidance for Infants and Kids (TIER 3)

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
AAP has issued 2026–2027 COVID-19 vaccine guidance for kids.

Recommended for all infants 6–23 months. Kids 2–18 not at increased risk can get one dose if parents choose.

Worth a call to your pediatrician before fall.
